title: Reports of a Stripe-OpenRouter acquisition
public_note: One outlet reports Stripe has finalized a deal to acquire the AI model marketplace OpenRouter for more than $7 billion; no second independently-sourced outlet or company confirmation yet.
reason: Wire-exclusive check (verification.md §2): Bloomberg (2026-08-16) reports Stripe has finalized a deal to acquire OpenRouter (an AI model marketplace/gateway, ~8M users claimed, 400+ models) for more than $7 billion. TechCrunch's same-day coverage explicitly attributes to Bloomberg ('according to a new report in Bloomberg') and adds no independent sourcing; a Yahoo Finance item is a syndication of the TechCrunch piece, not separate reporting. A separate, earlier report (WSJ via Axios, 2026-07-24) described early-stage talks at a different figure (~$10B) -- this is a different stage (non-binding talks vs. reported-signed deal) and a materially different number (>30% delta), so it does not corroborate today's specific $7B/finalized claim; the two reports are chained rumors from two different single-sourced wires (WSJ then Bloomberg), never simultaneously corroborating the same fact. Stripe told TechCrunch it does not comment on rumors/speculation; no OpenRouter statement found. OpenRouter's $113M Series B / $1.3B valuation (May 2026) is independently well-established background, not part of the rumor chain. This is a business/M&A claim requiring >=2 independent Tier<=2 sources or a filing, not met for the finalized $7B claim.
watch: A second wire/outlet with its own sourcing on the $7B figure or finalized status (not relaying Bloomberg)
An SEC filing or official Stripe/OpenRouter confirmation
The deal closing or being officially announced, which would itself be the cleaner news event
